Your Claude usage as a living glass of teh tarik.

- **Download** `TehTarikMeter-Setup-<version>.exe` below and run it. It installs for you only (no admin needed) and updates itself.
- Windows may say it "protected your PC" because the installer isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- On first run, click **Sign in to Claude** on the widget. Then, from the tray menu, choose **Connect Claude Code** for instant updates.
